document_info.title: Technical Specification for Data Sharing through API with FBR (Digital Invoicing)
document_info.note: This JSON was extracted and structured from the official PRAL PDF for developer reference. Before going to production, re-verify endpoints, tokens, and codes directly with FBR/PRAL, since tax rules and code lists can change over time.

api_endpoints.auth_note: Security token is issued through the FBR registration portal (e.fbr.gov.pk). Each registered business/integrator gets its own token.

integration_steps: Supply Chain Operator (SCO) registers with the FBR system.
Download the required software component from the FBR website and install it locally (internet connection required).
SCO is assigned a unique ID and issued a security (bearer) token.
SCO integrates their system (POS/ERP) with the FBR API using the provided endpoint and token.
On each sale/purchase/debit-note/credit-note, the SCO's system posts invoice data as JSON to the API.
On a successful call, FBR returns a unique tracking/invoice number (the 'result' field) which must be printed on the receipt along with a QR code for verification.
